Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Affiliate invoice routing and tax appendix (BrightSky Order Form)

Hi Irene / Kimberly —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Procurement has one follow-up before we sign: we need a short appendix that clarifies how invoices are routed when an affiliate/reseller is the paying party, and who is responsible for VAT/gross-up or local withholding. In particular: 

- Our EU affiliate (BrightSky EU Ltd) will be the billed entity for some orders; we need the order form to allow invoice routing to an affiliate without triggering warranty/indemnity shifts.
- For VAT/reverse-charge and any withholding taxes, we ask for a clear allocation of responsibility (BrightSky vs Redwood) and a request for evidence (tax certificates).
- We also want the activation fee to remain payable within 30 days of invoice — that is non-negotiable for our billing calendar.

I've attached a short draft appendix the procurement team proposed for speed. Could you confirm whether Redwood can accept this language or propose edits? If we can get a final by EOM next week that would keep our procurement sprint on track.

[Attachment: affiliate-appendix-draft.pdf (PDF, 38KB)]

Thanks —
Samantha Ortiz

Thanks for the draft. I'll loop in Legal to get redlines and we'll work with Sales on commercial impact (commit/min-commit dependencies). Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Affiliate invoice routing and tax appendix (BrightSky Order Form)

Irene / Samantha —

I've reviewed the attached appendix and propose the following redlines (summary + suggested contract language). High-level intent: allow invoice routing to an affiliate while preserving Redwood's commercial protections and ensuring tax/residency evidence is provided.

1) Invoice recipient language — allow "Invoice Recipient" to be the named affiliate if the affiliate is an affiliate of the contracting party and is listed in Appendix A. Add a short acceptance clause: Redwood must receive written notice of affiliate remit entity at least 10 business days prior to first invoice.

Suggested language: "Customer may designate an Affiliate as the Invoice Recipient by providing written notice to Redwood and completing the Affiliate Payment Annex. Redwood will accept such designation provided the Affiliate is a legal entity under common control with Customer and is included in Appendix A."

2) VAT and withholding allocation — require evidence + gross-up fallback. If a withholding is required by local law and Customer (or its Affiliate) is required to withhold amounts from payments to Redwood, Customer shall provide withholding tax receipts or certificates within 30 days of payment; absent timely evidence, Customer must promptly gross up payments so Redwood receives the full amount invoiced.

Suggested language: "Where any Withholding Taxes are imposed on payments due to Redwood, Customer shall provide Redwood with valid documentation evidencing the withholding within 30 days of the payment date. If such documentation is not provided within 30 days, Customer shall gross up the affected payment so that Redwood receives the full amount invoiced."

3) Activation fee timing — We can accept an Activation Fee Net30 when the invoice recipient is an Affiliate, provided Redwood receives a signed Affiliate Payment Annex and that the affiliate is the recipient of the invoice. However, for revenue recognition and minimum commit credits, the contracting entity must confirm whether invoice receipt by the affiliate counts toward the Customer's committed usage; if not, Sales to confirm.

4) Evidence attachment / audit rights — include a clause that Redwood may request reasonable evidence of affiliate status (e.g., shareholder or management confirmation) if there is suspicion of non-related third-party payment.

I've attached a tracked-change redline PDF for your review.

[Attachment: orderform-affiliate-appendix-redline.pdf (PDF, 47KB)]

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightskyhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Affiliate invoice routing and tax appendix (BrightSky Order Form)

All — quick commercial note from GTM: if invoice routing to BrightSky EU is accepted and counts toward the customer committed volume, we need to lock minimum commit attribution rules in the appendix. Otherwise we risk commit shortfalls. Recommended commercial compromise:

- Affiliate invoices count toward Customer commits if the affiliate is a direct legal subsidiary and the order form lists the affiliate in Appendix A;
- If affiliate is outside of the contracting entity family, invoices do NOT count toward commits and usage will be credited at a 20% discount until clarified;

If Legal's OK on the Net30 activation ask and evidence/gross-up clause, I can accept that commercially.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightskyhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Affiliate invoice routing and tax appendix (BrightSky Order Form)

Hi Kimberly / Irene —

Thanks for the quick review and the redline. BrightSky is able to provide the requested affiliate documentation (BrightSky EU Ltd, VAT GB999999999) and we can complete an Affiliate Payment Annex. A couple of clarifications from procurement: 

- We can't accept any clause that lets Redwood unilaterally treat the affiliate as non-counting for commits without a 30-day cure. Procurement needs a timeline to remedy any evidence deficiency before usage split or crediting kicks in.
- Activation fee timing: we must have activation payable Net30 from invoice. Can you confirm Redwood will route the activation invoice to BrightSky EU Ltd and that this will be accepted as counting toward the Customer's minimum commit?

If you're good with those two items, we'll prepare the Affiliate Payment Annex and sign — please send the final appendix and DocuSign link and we'll route for signature.

Best —
Samantha
